title: Folders
tooDeep: Folders go up to five levels.
missing: The folder in the address no longer exists. Showing everything.

moveDialog.title: Move “{{name}}” to…
moveDialog.label: Where it goes
moveDialog.self: It cannot go inside itself or its subfolders.

deleteDialog.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
deleteDialog.forms_one: The form stays in its other folders or in “No folder”.
deleteDialog.forms_other: The {{count}} forms stay in their other folders or in “No folder”.
deleteDialog.catalogs_one: The catalog stays in its other folders or in “No folder”.
deleteDialog.catalogs_other: The {{count}} catalogs stay in their other folders or in “No folder”.
deleteDialog.items_other: The {{count}} forms and catalogs stay in their other folders or in “No folder”.
deleteDialog.empty: It has no forms or catalogs.
deleteDialog.loadFailed: We couldn't count what the folder has.

menuDialog.title: “{{name}}” in the menu
menuDialog.iconHelp: It is what shows with the menu collapsed.
menuDialog.done: We saved the place of “{{name}}” in the menu.
